title: New Operator: GELU
body:
# New Operator

### Describe the operator

Activation function: Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU): https://paperswithcode.com/method/gelu

### Can this operator be constructed using existing onnx operators?

Current export behavior: 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/103593150/220924683-5da1ca1b-0864-43fd-9ec3-804d8be8b2a1.png)


### Is this operator used by any model currently? Which one?

It is used in recent popular models such as:
- Stable Diffusion: https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers/blob/f5ccffecf7c9c7b08c39043d1c9528be2c5cfecc/src/diffusers/models/attention.py#L395
- ConvNext: https://github.com/pytorch/vision/blob/ed48bb1c8c5cbb4dfaf18f4c27a47c42ce2bde27/torchvision/models/convnext.py#L55
- BERT, GPT-3, ... 

### Are you willing to contribute it? (Y/N)

N

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
What is the question?

Yes, Gelu can be defined in terms of existing ONNX operators. For example, onnxruntime has a custom op, defined as a function in terms of other onnx ops.

Is this a request/suggestion that Gelu be added to ONNX op list? That may be a very reasonable thing to do.

comments.author: reporter
comments.body:
@participant1 the question is indeed to add GELU to the ONNX op list. 
Thank you for considering the request.

comments.author: participant2
comments.body: This would be SO useful to convert MultiHeaded attention from Pytorch to TFLite

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
I concur, it would be quite helpful, in part also because there exists faster approx of GeLU, see https://pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.nn.GELU.html for example.

It is used also in Roberta, another important model.

So not only we would be able to cover more models, but having it may also enable us to lower the GeLU to a faster version that the current ERF based implementation.

@participant1 how do we get the ball rolling on this one?

comments.author: participant1
comments.body: It's a matter of creating a PR. It should be straightforward to migrate the op definition that exists in [onnxruntime](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/blob/main/onnxruntime/core/graph/contrib_ops/contrib_defs.cc#L550). Is there any volunteer? I can also bring it up in the weekly sync meetings or SIG meeting to find some volunteer.

comments.author: participant1
comments.body:
Summarizing a few points that were brought up in yesterday's SIG meeting:

* It would be useful to define both the regular Gelu, as well as its fast-approximation based on Tanh.
* Two options were discussed: for defining these two as two separate function-ops, or as one op with an attribute to choose between the two. The consensus was to define one op, with an attribute, similar to what pytorch does.
* It should be defined as a function-op: as a context-dependent function-op, that uses the attribute to return one of the two possible function-body definitions.
